credits.title: Ta Da Dum
credits.overview: A dark comedy musical about a newlywed couple whose relationship begins to unravel on the night that it officially begins.

credits.title: Happy Birthday
credits.overview: Eight-year-old maid Toha goes to great lengths to ensure that her best friend Nelly, the daughter of her wealthy employer, has a successful birthday party in this poignant debut feature exploring classism in modern-day Cairo.

credits.title: Youth
credits.overview: A teenager finds herself in new territory after she decides to approach her crush at a party. When they end up alone in his car, she is pushed to consider her own boundaries for the first time.
